command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the specify stage writes only under $change/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: tasks.md 7.1: the NFR-A1 Scenario Outline 'Offsets have no accessibility violations in the <theme> theme' lists its steps (stored Kolkata/Kathmandu/New York; the user opens the locations app; the row shows the offset; the locations screen has no accessibility violations) but omits the existing step 'the locations screen uses the <theme> theme' (locations_view_a11y_e2e.steps.ts: /^the locations screen uses the (light|dark) theme$/). Without it both examples run in the default theme, so NFR-A1 ('axe-core reports no violations ... in the light and dark themes') and M4 ('2 themes (2 checks)') are not actually verified; design D6 lists the step but the task does not.

tasks.md 7.2: verification includes 'inspect that the new baselines show `UTC+5` and `UTC+3`', which is a manual visual check, contrary to the acceptance criterion 'A task whose verification is a manual check fails' and .claude/rules/test-planning.md ('Manual testing ... should be a last resort'). Replace it with an automated assertion, e.g. the new step 'the row of "Almaty" shows the offset "UTC+5"' (and Moscow 'UTC+3') before 'the locations screen matches the approved screenshot'.

tasks.md 7.2 both re-approves the 8 existing 'Screenshot-of-the-list-state-*' baselines and adds a new Scenario Outline 'Screenshot of the list with offsets at <width> px in the <theme> theme' with the same steps, which creates 8 more identical baselines. The proposal (Impact: 'the 8 approved "list" screenshots ... are re-approved'; NFR-R2) promises only re-approval. Keep one: either tag/re-approve the existing outline or replace it, not both.
